type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M)
  (ψ : ↥M.K),
  Transcendental ℚ ψ →
    ∀ (x : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint ↥M.K) (h : ψ ∈ ↑x.P) {g : ℚ[X]},
      g ≠ 0 →
        x.P.ord ((Polynomial.aeval ψ) g) =
          AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ramIdx M hDVR ψ x.P *
            ↑(Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (x.eval ψ h)
                (Polynomial.map (Algebra.algebraMap ℚ AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Qbar) g))
name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalPolynomialOrderAtRegularPoint

type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N),
  AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M →
    ∀ (ψ : ↥M.K),
      Transcendental ℚ ψ →
        ∀ (P : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place ↥M.K),
          ψ ∉ ↑P → ∀ {p : ℚ[X]}, p ≠ 0 → P.ord ((Polynomial.aeval ψ) p) = ↑p.natDegree * P.ord ψ
name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalPolynomialOrderAtPole

type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M)
  (ψ : ↥M.K),
  Transcendental ℚ ψ →
    ∀ (x : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint ↥M.K),
      AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ramIdx M hDVR ψ⁻¹ x.P = AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ramIdx M hDVR ψ x.P
name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalInverseRamification
